source_context.summary: First end-to-end RGP-to-Steward admission trial. The graph exercises new generic propositions, premise derivation, supports relations, immutable GitHub provenance resolution, and reconciliation to an existing canonical PEMS decision.

records.statement: The RGP Submission Protocol requires committed candidate submissions to remain immutable.
The RGP Submission Protocol prohibits RGP producers from writing directly to the canonical PEMS/COVE handoff artifacts.
Candidate RGP production and canonical PEMS persistence are separate operations.

The Project Engineering Steward owns reconciliation of canonical PEMS meaning; accepted reconciliation regenerates docs/project-chat-handoff.cove.json canonically and docs/project-chat-handoff.json as its deterministic compatibility derivative.
